what: Patreon's main explore page (https://www.patreon.com/explore) returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch. The server-side HTML visible in search engine index contains only skeleton placeholder content.
verbatim_snippet: n/a — access failure finding. Search engine index of the URL shows: "Explore topics · Topic placeholder · Topic placeholder · Topic placeholder · Dummy creator name · This is a dummy creator description · Loading content"
notes: The page is entirely JavaScript-rendered (client-side SPA). Server-side HTML contains only skeleton elements: "Topic placeholder" (repeated), "Dummy creator name," "This is a dummy creator description," "Loading content." No actual category names, creator names, tier prices, or counts are present in the server-rendered HTML visible to search engine crawlers. All 7 primary explore URLs and all 10 secondary category explore URLs returned identical 403 errors.
